title: Goblin Tools vs ChatGPT: Which AI Breaks Down Tasks Better?
caption: Video: Goblin Tools vs ChatGPT in five rounds, plus a bonus round (2:45)
description: Goblin Tools or ChatGPT? Goblin Tools if one task is stuck right now and you have no energy to explain, ChatGPT if the task is messy and needs context and follow-up questions. Five rounds: getting steps fast, knowing your situation, steps you can actually start, staying on track, and help with the work itself.
